title: epan: convert dissectors B to C99 types (rerun script)

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 2b757660 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 40801edc - epan: convert dissectors B to C99 types (rerun script)
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16450/diffs?diff_id=1066567453&start_sha=ebdcfb3699106be89803e6faebec0807b7869bad)

Please keep the gboolean for the API using glib types.
This line was already fixed once in 3275e6fb18ade0bc4a83af0ddc471e46754e6abe.
maybe all g\_\*() should be ignored by the script?

Yes, we should keep using TRUE/FALSE for glib functions using gboolean (as discussed somewhere, I think the concern was made by @JaapKeuter).

It's already a mess after the last big changes, but let's try to revert the mistakes as best as possible before continuing the dissectors path.

Some discussion also mentioned that glib handled bool?

Den ons 17 juli 2024 11:44Stig Bjørlykke (@stigbjorlykke) <
gitlab@mg.gitlab.com> skrev:

I missed this discussion, and obviously the latest glib change.
I'll retract my comment about using TRUE/FALSE, let the script do it's work.
okej, then revert the two correction MR?

The glib change was reverted due to C++ breakage: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/commit/db419ffbdeb55d653de05af01a4ba8bad71ba770

Though it should be ok to pass constant bool values to functions (but not pointers to bools, or the wrong return values), casting should work properly.
